dialogue.content: ポピーさん、おはようございます。今日は宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good morning, Poppy. I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I look forward to working with you, too.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、始めさせていただいてもよろしいでしょか？
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but would it be alright if we get started?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: おはようございます、相談員です。相談にあたり、呼び名（ニックネーム可）、年齢、性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Good morning, I'm the counselor. For our consultation, could you please tell me your preferred name (a nickname is fine), your age, and your gender?

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 中1男子　しゅうくん、修くんでお願いします
dialogue.English: I'm a first-year junior high school boy. Please call me Shu-kun or Shu.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます、修くん。今日のご相談はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you, Shu-kun. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 部活で悩んでます
dialogue.English: I'm having a problem with my school club.

dialogue.content: 部活…。部活のどんなことで悩んでるんですか？
dialogue.English: Your school club... What specifically about it are you struggling with?

dialogue.content: この前のテストの結果がよくなくて、父から部活をやめるよう言われてます。自分はやめたくないんで
dialogue.English: My results on a recent test weren't good, and my dad is telling me to quit my club. But I don't want to quit.

dialogue.content: 修くんは部活をやめたくいのに、成績を理由にお父さんが辞めろと言うのですね。部活は続けていきたいですよね。
dialogue.English: So, Shu-kun, you don't want to quit your club, but your father is telling you to because of your grades. You really want to continue with it, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何部に入っているんですか？
dialogue.English: What club are you in?

dialogue.content: テニスです
dialogue.English: Tennis.

dialogue.content: さわやかなイメージのスポーツですね。テニスを選んだ理由とか、今の部活の様子を教えてくれますか？
dialogue.English: That's a sport with a refreshing image. Can you tell me why you chose tennis and what your club is like now?

dialogue.content: テニスはTVでみて楽しそうだと〜始めてみて、すごく楽しいです。まだ試合にでたことはないけど、試合にでれるよう頑張りたい
dialogue.English: I saw tennis on TV and thought it looked fun, so I started playing, and it's really enjoyable. I haven't been in a match yet, but I want to work hard so I can play in one.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。そうですよね。実際やっていて楽しく出来ているのですね。１年生だし、始まったばかりでこれからという時に、お父さんに言われて嫌でしたね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're really enjoying it now that you're playing. It must have been upsetting to be told that by your father, especially since you're a first-year student and you've just begun.

dialogue.content: 学校生活で1番楽しいのがテニス部活の時間です
dialogue.English: My tennis club is the most fun part of my school life.

dialogue.content: はい、父にはいつも姉と比べられて嫌ですね
dialogue.English: Yes, my dad always compares me to my older sister, and I hate it.

dialogue.content: 姉は成績優秀です
dialogue.English: My sister gets excellent grades.

dialogue.content: いま、とてもテニスに打ち込めているのですね。学校に行くのにも気持ちに張りができますね。お姉さんと比べられてしまうのですね。それで、成績に関してはとても厳しいお父さんなのですね。
dialogue.English: So you're very dedicated to tennis right now. It must give you something to look forward to at school. And you get compared to your sister. It sounds like your father is very strict about grades.

dialogue.content: この前のテストの成績が悪くてということでしたが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned your scores on the recent test weren't good,

dialogue.content: 部活を辞めろと言われてしまうほどの点数だったんですか？
dialogue.English: Were the scores bad enough for him to tell you to quit the club?

dialogue.content: はい。志望の高校に合格するには、お前には部活との両立は無理と言います
dialogue.English: Yes. He says that if I want to get into my target high school, I can't possibly manage both the club and my studies.

dialogue.content: 志望校合格ギリギリの点数でした
dialogue.English: My score was just on the borderline for getting into my target school.

dialogue.content: そんなことを今から決めつけられて悔しいですね。点数は、そうでしたか・・・。この前のテストがということでしたが、修くんとしては、この間のテスト勉強はどんな感じでしたか？
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating to be written off like that already. I see about the score... Regarding that last test, how did your studying go, from your perspective?

dialogue.content: 夏休みにのんびりしすぎたのは反省です
dialogue.English: I regret that I slacked off too much during summer vacation.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。それは、修くんとしてはやろうと思えばまだ出来るという気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So, you feel that if you put your mind to it, you can still do better?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あまり自信ないけど
dialogue.English: Though I'm not very confident.

dialogue.content: 修くんは、テストの成績が悪くてお父さんに部活を辞めろと言われているけど、部活は楽しいしこれから試合も出たい。辞めずに両立していきたい。そのために、お父さんを説得したいということでいいですか？
dialogue.English: Let me see if I have this right, Shu-kun. Your father told you to quit your club because of your poor test scores, but you enjoy your club and want to play in matches someday. You want to balance both without quitting, and to do that, you need to convince your father. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい、父にわかって欲しいです
dialogue.English: Yes, I want my dad to understand.

dialogue.content: でも、姉ほど頭よくないのは確かで、あまり自信ないんです
dialogue.English: But it's true I'm not as smart as my sister, so I don't have much confidence.

dialogue.content: そうですね。いまテニスは諦めたくないからお父さんに理解して欲しいですよね。修くんは、これまでずっとお姉さんと比べられてきたのですね。お姉さんは、あまり努力しなくてもできちゃうタイプなのかな？
dialogue.English: I understand. You don't want to give up tennis now, so you want your father to understand. It sounds like you've been compared to your sister for a long time. Is she the type who can do well without much effort?

dialogue.content: はい。全く羨ましい
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm totally envious.

dialogue.content: そっか、そっか。同じ姉弟なのにって思っちゃいますよね。修くんはお姉さんとは違った面の良さがあると思うんだけど、どうかな？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. It's natural to think, "We're siblings, but..." I'm sure you have your own good qualities that are different from your sister's, don't you think?

dialogue.content: うん。姉はけっこう自己中なので、ぼくの方がまわりへのおもいやりあるかな
dialogue.English: Yeah. My sister is pretty self-centered, so I think I'm more considerate of others.

dialogue.content: それはとても大事なことだし、集団生活でも役立ちそうですね。きっと、部活でもそういう面は生きてくると思いますよ。それで、お父さんに分かってもらうためになんだけど、どんなことを言ったらお父さんは分かってくれそうに思う？
dialogue.English: That's a very important quality, and it's helpful in group settings. I'm sure that aspect of your personality will serve you well in your club, too. Now, about getting your father to understand, what do you think you could say that might get through to him?

dialogue.content: 勉強もっと頑張るとか？
dialogue.English: Like, that I'll study harder?

dialogue.content: うん、うん。それは、具体的にはテストの点数ってことなのかな？
dialogue.English: Uh-huh. Specifically, does that mean improving your test scores?

dialogue.content: 夏休みはちょっと緩んじゃったみたいだけど、点数だけではないのかな？お父さん。。。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you slacked off a bit during summer vacation, but maybe for your father, it's not just about the scores...

dialogue.content: 頑張ってもテストの点があがるかあんまり自信ないけど、とにかく今より勉強時間をふやすことはできるかな
dialogue.English: I'm not very confident my test scores will go up even if I try, but I think I can at least increase my study time.

dialogue.content: 父はテスト結果をすごく気にします
dialogue.English: My dad really cares about test results.

dialogue.content: 部活が忙しくても勉強時間を確保して一生懸命取り組むこと、そして、テストの結果も出さないと納得してもらえない感じなんだね。
dialogue.English: So it feels like he won't be convinced unless you secure study time even when you're busy with your club, work hard, and also get results on your tests. Is that right?

dialogue.content: 姉と同じ高校に入学してほしい気持ちがすごく強いので
dialogue.English: He really wants me to get into the same high school as my sister.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。修くんも今はそう思ってるの？
dialogue.English: I see. Is that what you want too, Shu-kun?

dialogue.content: できればそうしたい。大学行きたいから
dialogue.English: I'd like to, if possible, because I want to go to university.

dialogue.content: そっか。じゃ、頑張りたいところだね。まだ１年生だけど、志望校には届くかっていうのは偏差値とかで分かるのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. So that's something you want to work toward. You're still in your first year, but can you tell if you're on track for your target school from things like standardized scores?

dialogue.content: どうかな？とりあえずは学年の順位とかが大事みたい
dialogue.English: I'm not sure. For now, it seems like my rank in the grade is what's important.

dialogue.content: 偏差値でなくて学年順位が分かるんだね。部活は楽しく出来ているけど、練習で疲れすぎたり時間がなくなって勉強できなくなったりは、してないかな？
dialogue.English: So you know your grade ranking, not a standardized score. You're enjoying your club, but do you ever get too tired from practice or run out of time to study?

dialogue.content: たしかにそういう日もある、
dialogue.English: There are definitely days like that,

dialogue.content: でもTVみてる時間とか削って、勉強時間をふやすことはできそう
dialogue.English: but I think I can cut back on TV time and increase my study time.

dialogue.content: そうだね、そういう時間のやりくりを見直せるよね。ただ、ダラダラやっても効率悪いし短時間でも集中できればいいとお思うんだ。お父さんには、勉強を頑張るって言うわけだけど具体的にどう頑張ったら納得してもらえそうかな？
dialogue.English: Right, you can reevaluate how you manage your time. Studying aimlessly is inefficient; I think it's better to be focused, even for a short time. You're going to tell your father you'll study harder, but what specific actions do you think might convince him?

dialogue.content: やはり、テストで学年順位を上げることかな
dialogue.English: I guess raising my grade rank on tests.

dialogue.content: じゃ、それを宣言してやってみない？部活を続けていくためには、やっぱりやることやっていかないと、またお父さんに言われちゃうけど、できそうかな？
dialogue.English: Then why don't you make that your goal and give it a try? To continue with your club, you'll have to do what needs to be done, otherwise your dad will say something again. Do you think you can do it?

dialogue.content: うん。父に話してみます。勉強もっと頑張るからテニス続けさせてと
dialogue.English: Yeah. I'll try talking to my dad. I'll tell him I'll study harder and ask him to let me continue with tennis.

dialogue.content: そうだね、修くんも志望校に受かりたいし、テニスもやりたいしだものね。
dialogue.English: That's right. Because you want to get into your target high school and you also want to play tennis.

dialogue.content: はい、頑張ってみます！
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll do my best!

dialogue.content: 応援してますね。今日の相談でお話ししたかったことはお話し出来たかな？
dialogue.English: I'll be rooting for you. Were you able to talk about everything you wanted to during our session today?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。はい、話せました。気持ちの整理もできました。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you. Yes, I was able to talk things through. I was able to sort out my feelings, too. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談に来てくれてありがとうございました。また、何かあったら相談に来てくださいね。それでは、今日は失礼します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. If anything else comes up, please feel free to come back. Well then, that's all for today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: 相談者役、有難うございました。＆お疲れ様でした。これで、ロープレを終了します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your role as the client. And great work. This concludes the role-play.

dialogue.content: 相談者役、有難うございました。＆お疲れ様でした。これで、ロープレを終了します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your role as the client. And great work. This concludes the role-play.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.
